node.statement: F2 ANNEALED/PHASE SPLIT (2026-07-10, campaign cycle 81; digest F2_ANNEALED_PHASE_SPLIT_PASS): the consumer contract's Fourier anatomy, pinned. (I) CENSUS-FOURIER IDENTITY (orthogonality, exact; verified integer-exact against the DP census at (97,32,j=2), all b): N_b^(j) = (1/q^j) sum_{c in F_q^j} [z^b] prod_{x in mu_n}(1 + z psi(c.(x,..,x^j))). The period product splits into MODULUS field S_c = sum_x log|1+psi(c.xbar)| (= the satellites-16/17 field) and PHASE field Phi_c. (II) ANNEALED DEATH CONSTANT: E_c[exp(S_c)] = (4/pi)^{n(1+o(1))} under phase equidistribution (E_theta|1+e(i theta)| = 4/pi, one line); at official depth q^t = 2^{2.15e12} >> exp(0.411 n) the Gaussian tail is fully available, so ANY absolute/triangle-inequality route (annealed, max, or L-value moments of |S|) misses the n^3 budget by >= n log2(4/pi) ~ 0.3485 n ~ 3.8e11 bits — the required signed recovery is the ENTIRE annealed mass; no bound on |S| alone can close the contract. Measured at 6 rows: rates 0.10-0.26 nats/root, every deviation from the ideal explained and checked (CATCH #20: finite-frequency-population cap — q^j points cannot realize the tail S ~ 0.822n unless j log q > 0.411 n; sampled estimators are tail-blind/biased-low, the sample-max-dominated formula (maxS - log N)/n reproduced every low rate to 0.001; the exact-population j=3 rate 0.2569 slightly EXCEEDS the discrete envelope 0.2416 — mild positive dependence — the death constant is a FLOOR). (III) PHASE FIELD = GENERALIZED DEDEKIND SUM (proved per-factor: arg(1+e(i theta)) = theta/2, psi never -1 at odd q): Phi_c = pi * sum_{x in mu_n} ((c.xbar/q)) with ((.)) the centered sawtooth — verified to 5e-13 at all rows. REDIRECT (the split's consequence for the summit lane): the census's needed cancellation is the mod-2pi oscillation of Phi_c — a SAWTOOTH/DEDEKIND SUM OVER THE SUBGROUP, the exact classical home of Dedekind reciprocity and Vardi/Conrey distribution theory; the L-function diagonalization governs the modulus component, reciprocity must govern the phase. Verifier: critical/nodes/u2c_giant_tnull_dichotomy/notes/f2_annealed_phase_split_modal.py. Eighteenth satellite; the summit's open content now has coordinates: (modulus, phase) = (L-values at 1, Dedekind sawtooth sums).
